title: Indiana Dunes Is America’s Newest National Park
summary: Мичиган нуурын эргийн элсэн манхант Индиана Дюнс АНУ-ын хамгийн шинэ үндэсний парк болжээ.

source.name: VOA Learning English
source.credit: Erika Celeste, Ashley Thompson · VOA Learning English
source.creditLine: Erika Celeste reported this story for VOA News. Ashley Thompson adapted it for VOA Learning English, using earlier Learning English reports by Jerilyn Watson. Kelly Jean Kelly was the editor.

questions.prompt: What is the main news in this story?
options: Indiana Dunes became a national park
Indiana Dunes was closed to visitors
A new port was built on Lake Michigan
questions.explain: "It became Indiana Dunes National Park in February" гэж бичсэн. Энэ бол АНУ-ын хамгийн шинэ үндэсний парк.

options: People who worked in steel mills
Rivers that flow into the lake
questions.explain: "Strong winds from Lake Michigan ... created the park’s sand dunes over time" гэж бичсэн.

questions.prompt: Why do visitors say that the sand dunes "sing"?
options: The sand makes a musical sound when people walk on it
Birds sing loudly in the dunes every morning
Music is played for visitors along the lakeshore
